current.text: He is a rookie. The Kings traded up to pick 29 in the 2026 draft to take him.
He is not in the projected Kings rotation. The starters are Acuff, LaVine, Murray, Simmons and Sabonis, and the bench is Hunter, Monk, Raynaud, Achiuwa and Clifford.
He averaged 8 points on 16.5% usage in Summer League.
Lloyd thought he looked bad in Summer League and does not expect him to be a rotation player.
Experts rank him below his draft slot and did not like the Kings trading up for him.
The Kings are projected near the bottom of the league, and their rotations are unpredictable.

durable.text: He was already 23 at the draft and had a 17% usage role in college.
He is a low-usage shooter who does little else. The comparisons are a much worse Duncan Robinson or a Steve Novak outcome.
His game translates poorly to fantasy. At best he is a rotation player with little fantasy appeal.
